create_scorer_rouge_1: create a Rouge1Scorer to compute ROUGE-1 scores for hypothesis and reference sentence lists
create_scorer_rouge_2: create a Rouge2Scorer to compute ROUGE-2 scores for hypothesis and reference sentence lists
create_scorer_rouge_l: create a RougeLScorer to compute ROUGE-L scores for hypothesis and reference sentence lists
run_get_sent_rouge: run _get_sent_rouge to compute per-sentence ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, or ROUGE-L recall scores
test_rouge_scorers: test the registered ROUGE scorers (rouge_1, rouge_2, rouge_l) with hypothesis and reference inputs
